claim: Nigeria’s Ngozi Okonjo-Iweala has been appointed the new and first female Director-General of the World Trade Organisation (WTO).
justification: The high-confidence evidence from the retrieval-based fact-checker, including multiple items with confidence scores of 0.95 and 1.00, consistently confirms that Ngozi Okonjo-Iweala is Nigerian, was appointed as WTO Director-General on October 5, 2020, and is the first female in the role, with official WTO press releases cited as primary sources. The single low-confidence contradicted item (confidence 0.10) is discounted as untrustworthy, and the knowledge-only fact-check's refutation lacks corroborating high-confidence evidence in the pool. Therefore, the claim is supported by trustworthy evidence.
